reason: I already have my gummies that I reorder when they run out, and I forget pills half the time as it is. Two capsules every evening is one more thing I would not stick to.
objection: Two capsules a day is a chore, and I would end up with a box of sachets sitting on the counter. I also don't know this brand and I'm happy with what I take now.
would_change_my_mind: A single easy gummy or one capsule, and a real reason to switch from what I already reorder, like a clearly lower price per day.
